delivery_mixed_runs.why: build_delivery's own refusal (workflow._refuse in services/assistant_tools.py, AA-05 S2): the selected charts come from different solves or input states, or mix a chart without a recorded run with one that has one. Nothing is written; the model offers to deliver them separately.

artifact_quarantined.why: create_chart's and the table exports' own refusal (workflow._refuse in services/assistant_tools.py and services/chat_tools.py, AA-05 S2 H8 and S3 R8): an identical redraw or re-export would reuse the file id of a chart that failed an integrity check, and a quarantined file is never published again. Nothing is written; the model tells the user the chart is unavailable and does not retry the same call.
